result.title: Task-Performance Routing for Multi-Teacher Distillation in CT Medical Image Segmentation
result.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/EdvinCecilia/TPR_MultiTeacher
result.summary: Pre-trained models offer complementary strengths in CT organ segmentation, but their relative accuracy varies across organs and spatial regions. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation can combine these strengths in a single student, yet global or instance-level teacher weights overlook variation within a 3D volume. We propose Task-Performance Routing (TPR), which uses region-wise segmentation errors to determine teacher weights during training without learned routing parameters. In hard regions, TPR favors teachers with lower prediction errors; in easy regions, it uses uniform weights to combine their knowledge. A hierarchical spatial partition provides fine-grained routing in shallow encoder stages and coarse-grained routing in deep stages. Experiments on BTCV, MSD-Liver, and MSD-Pancreas with two teacher pairs and two backbone architectures show higher Dice scores than the individual teachers, adaptive ensembles, and evaluated multi-teacher distillation baselines. On MSD-Pancreas, TPR achieves Dice scores of 65.40% with SwinUNETR and 68.25% with U-Net, compared with 64.38% and 67.45% for the corresponding adaptive ensembles. Inference uses the student alone, with no routing or teacher overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/EdvinCecilia/TPR_MultiTeacher.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Task-Performance Routing（TPR），在 CT 器官分割的多教师蒸馏训练中，依据区域级分割误差为各教师分配权重——困难区域偏向低误差教师，简单区域用均匀权重，并用分层空间划分实现浅层细粒度、深层粗粒度路由；推理仅用学生模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按区域误差自适应分配教师贡献、无需学习路由参数」的思路，可能为 LVR 中依据视觉证据区域进行监督分配与贡献分配提供线索，但属医学分割训练侧工作，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接关联，可供核查迁移可行性。
